title: Real Provider Integration Runtime
implemented_contracts: existing R3 provider.run(request) contract remains unchanged
ProviderRegistry requires explicit provider registration and has no silent fallback
ProviderRuntime owns provider/model policy enrichment and rejects caller-supplied provider_policy
AI Run Records bind canonical request-plus-policy input hashes and structured-output hashes
AI Run Records preserve requested model alias separately from provider-resolved model_version provenance
same model family can serve Designer, Builder, Builder Repair and Verifier while prompt/context/source/goal metadata remain distinct
Model Policy snapshots caller model configuration at construction time to preserve deterministic resolution
output schema registry resolves only the four accepted R3 DBV artifact schemas
role prompts explicitly prohibit canonical/truth authority and hidden-reasoning disclosure
GLM adapter uses HTTPS Bearer-authenticated chat/completions transport with JSON-object response mode
GLM adapter uses Node built-in fetch and adds no SDK dependency
GLM adapter rejects tool-call completion and does not enable tools, web search, MCP or arbitrary function execution
GLM reasoning_content is discarded and only a boolean discard marker may cross the adapter boundary
GLM API key is stored in a JavaScript private field and is absent from serialized adapter state
provider errors and timeout errors are sanitized and do not interpolate API keys or provider response bodies
provider request and prompt boundaries recursively reject explicit credential fields
existing R3 DBV loop runs unchanged through ProviderRuntime and produces one immutable run record per provider call
normal npm run check uses Fake Provider and injected fetch only; no real network is required
manual pilot:glm path requires GLM_API_KEY and never falls back to Fake Provider

provider_compatibility.compatibility_note: Model availability can vary by provider endpoint/account. R6 treats the model string and base URL as deployment configuration rather than canonical protocol identity.

known_boundaries.live_connectivity: not verified because no GLM_API_KEY was available
known_boundaries.model_availability: deployment-specific; GLM_MODEL and GLM_BASE_URL are configurable
known_boundaries.structured_output: R6 uses JSON object mode but existing R3 semantic validators remain required
known_boundaries.hidden_reasoning: reasoning_content is discarded and is neither a review artifact nor inter-role context
known_boundaries.canonical_authority: none; provider output cannot bypass R4/R5 or canonical policy

final_head_verification.reason: committing this validation artifact creates a new branch HEAD that must independently pass OCME CI and Lean CI

acceptance_rule: R6 implementation is FINAL_ACCEPTED only after the validation-artifact HEAD passes both OCME CI and Lean CI. Live GLM connectivity remains a separately tracked state and must not be inferred from implementation acceptance.
